spoken_summary: Mike Johnson states that the definition of marriage, which he claims had been consistent for 5,000 years, was changed. He notes that when five Supreme Court justices made this change, it became "the law of the land."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Mike Johnson's voice from the interview clip. There is no music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot of a talking-head interview with no cuts or special effects.
central_claim: House Speaker Mike Johnson is unhappy that the Supreme Court legalized gay marriage, which he views as an alteration of a long-standing societal definition.
intended_effect: To portray Mike Johnson as being against marriage equality and to generate disapproval of his views.
